    four=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==4]
    (a,b)=four
    dr=b[0]-a[0]; dc=b[1]-a[1]
    # Copy object in the direction perpendicular to the line joining the markers.
    # axis-aligned marker lines produce side-by-side copies.
    if dr==0: vr,vc=1,0
    elif dc==0: vr,vc=0,1
    elif abs(dr)==abs(dc): vr,vc=1,-1
    else: vr,vc=0,1
    out=[row[:] for row in obj]
    # Default doubled along direction indicated by perpendicular marker displacement.
    h,w=len(obj),len(obj[0])
    if vr==1 and vc==-1:
        # retain bounding rectangle of two diagonal copies
        out=[[0]*(2*w-1) for _ in range(2*h-1)]
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):

                out[i+h-1][j+w-1]=obj[i][j]
    elif vr==1:
        out=[row[:] + row[:] for row in obj]
    else:
        out=obj+[row[:] for row in obj]
    return out
